title: N.C.R.B., (M.H.A.) PRISON STATISTICS - 1996 The analysis of type of the female inmates shows that as in the case of total prison inmates, the percentage share of undertrial women prisoners was also very high when compared to other type of prison inmates. Barring Nagaland, Sikkim and Dada & Nagar Haveli, the percentage share varied around 40% to 96% in the above states. The female prisoners in Nagaland (11), Sikkim (4) and Dadra & Nagar Haveli (2) kept in the Jail were all Undertrials (100%). The other States which recorded high percentage of Undertrials women prisons to the total women inmates were West Bengal (95.6%), Uttar Pradesh (92.2%) and UT of Delhi (90%). Among the total women inmates held in the Prisons of Tamil Nadu, the highest percentage (59.9%) was of convicted women prisoners. The other States which reported sizeable percentage of female convicts as inmates were Meghalaya (57.5%), Kerala (52.8%), Mizoram (48.1%), Madhya Pradesh (33.5%), Maharashtra (30.1%), Rajasthan (29.1%) and Jammu & Kashmir (28%).
